original_exam_questions: State the purpose of DNS. [2 marks]
Resolves domain names to IP addresses.
Distinguish IP and MAC addresses. [4 marks]
IP used for logical addressing/routing across networks; MAC identifies a network interface for local data-link forwarding.
Name a suitable protocol for sending email. [1 mark]

optional_original_challenge.coreHint: The equality test checks the literal string HTTPS.

stretch.task: Add ELSE IF to recognise SMTP as mail sending; test HTTPS, HTTP and SMTP.
stretch.hint: Use another conditional branch, not three separate unguarded IFs.
stretch.answer: HTTPS -> encrypted web, SMTP -> mail sending, HTTP -> other/unrecognised.

mastery.task: Make a simple protocol classifier for HTTP, HTTPS, SMTP, IMAP and unknown values; explain why a classifier is not a security guarantee.
mastery.hint: Test each known string and include a default.
mastery.answer: HTTP web, HTTPS encrypted web, SMTP sending mail, IMAP retrieving/synchronising mail, unknown remains unrecognised. Treat user input case appropriately.
